baseline_result_file: docs/backtesting.md current canonical baseline and same-run before_metrics inside this artifact

gate4.note: Even if numeric Gate 4 passes, this runner is not accepted alpha because the shared daily allocator helper was not changed.

hypothesis: candidate_pool/allocation: when accepted default-off paper sources compete for the same daily allocator slot, selecting the candidate with lower PIT OHLCV correlation crowding versus same-day competitors may avoid crowded beta/theme exposure and outperform fixed source priority while preserving the accepted allocator execution envelope.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping correlation thresholds, correlation weights, source ranks, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, cooldown, or fixed state cells on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.negative_reflection: If rejected, low same-day peer correlation is too weak or too noisy to explain source-choice replacement. If positive, the result remains non-accepted because shared helper parity is missing.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs closed forward source-competition replacement rows, a materially richer PIT relation field, or a shared daily helper recording the field before replay promotion.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The correlation-crowding proxy did not improve fixed source priority robustly enough across the canonical windows. This suggests same-day source-choice errors are not primarily a simple crowded-beta issue, or the useful relation field needs forward replacement evidence rather than frozen-window arbitration.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/allocation: when accepted default-off paper sources compete for the same daily allocator slot, selecting the candidate with lower PIT OHLCV correlation crowding versus same-day competitors may avoid crowded beta/theme exposure and outperform fixed source priority while preserving the accepted allocator execution envelope.

2_history_check.exp-20260611-005: Accepted lagged-consensus shared allocator source and binding comparator: aggregate EV +2.1849 and PnL +$40,397.21.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-003: Observed-only same-day source-choice oracle found a material gap, but used future PnL and required a PIT arbitration field.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-004: Rejected trailing closed-PnL source maturity allocator; avoid performance chasing and lookback/min-history retries.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-006: Rejected source-score percentile allocator; avoid source rank, source-score percentile, top-N, hold, notional, or cooldown near-neighbor retunes.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-009: Rejected candidate microstructure allocator; avoid retesting trend, close-location, volume, volatility, or extension bundles.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-015: Rejected same-ticker source confirmation allocator; avoid confirmation-count retries.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. The variant must improve aggregate EV and PnL versus the same-run accepted allocator control, avoid direct EV/PnL regression in every window, retain sample and survival guards, keep drawdown drift <= 0.5pp, and beat the accepted exp-20260611-005 comparator. A positive replay result is only a lead until shared helper and daily parity are implemented.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260613-003 showed a material same-day source-choice oracle gap. exp-20260613-004, exp-20260613-006, exp-20260613-009, and exp-20260613-015 ruled out source maturity, source-score percentile, price microstructure quality, and same-ticker confirmation. PIT correlation crowding is a distinct free-data portfolio field.

execution_envelope.notes: Same accepted-helper allocator execution envelope as exp-20260611-005. This scout does not change production; positive evidence would require a shared helper and daily snapshot parity before retention.

production_impact.parity_note: Replay-only correlation-crowding scout. It reuses accepted allocator source rows and computes PIT OHLCV return-correlation context through the signal-day close before next-open paper entry. No source helper, daily snapshot, report, ranking, sizing, exit, watchlist, LLM/news, or order surface is changed.
